+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_send_denial_streaming_response() -> None:
+    background_call_count = 0
+    messages: list[Message] = []
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.connect"}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        messages.append(message)
+
+    async def stream() -> AsyncIterator[str | bytes]:
+        yield "foo"
+        yield b"bar"
+
+    async def background() -> None:
+        nonlocal background_call_count
+        background_call_count += 1
+
+    scope: Scope = {"type": "websocket", "headers": [], "extensions": {"websocket.http.response": {}}}
+    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+    await websocket.receive()
+    response = StreamingResponse(stream(), status_code=404, background=BackgroundTask(background))
+    await websocket.send_denial_response(response)
+
+    assert [message["type"] for message in messages] == [
+        "websocket.http.response.start",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+    ]
+    assert messages[0]["status"] == 404
+    assert b"".join(message["body"] for message in messages[1:]) == b"foobar"
+    assert [message.get("more_body", False) for message in messages[1:]] == [True, True, False]
+    assert background_call_count == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_send_denial_file_response(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "denial.txt"
+    content = b"file denial"
+    path.write_bytes(content)
+    messages: list[Message] = []
+
+    class AsyncFile:
+        async def __aenter__(self) -> "AsyncFile":
+            return self
+
+        async def __aexit__(self, *args: object) -> None:
+            pass
+
+        async def read(self, size: int) -> bytes:
+            return content
+
+    async def open_file(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> AsyncFile:
+        return AsyncFile()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(anyio, "open_file", open_file)
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.connect"}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        messages.append(message)
+
+    scope: Scope = {
+        "type": "websocket",
+        "headers": [],
+        "extensions": {"websocket.http.response": {}, "http.response.pathsend": {}},
+    }
+    websocket = WebSocket(scope, receive=receive, send=send)
+    await websocket.receive()
+    await websocket.send_denial_response(FileResponse(path, status_code=403, stat_result=path.stat()))
+
+    assert [message["type"] for message in messages] == [
+        "websocket.http.response.start",
+        "websocket.http.response.body",
+    ]
+    assert messages[0]["status"] == 403
+    assert messages[1]["body"] == content
+
